_comment: SHADOW MANIFEST — deliberately NOT under desks/.
file anywhere under desks/ would make sync_desk_config() write a US desk
and source into the tracked production database on the next migration run,
which would put a non-collecting desk into public counts. It lives here so
production discovery cannot see it by accident, and a test asserts that
Nothing in this file is read by pipeline.py. Only the shadow runner reads
it, and the shadow runner writes only to the shadow state branch.
The us-indopacific entry in desks/registry.json stays 'access_blocked'.
That status is about www.pacom.mil, which still returns HTTP 403 for its
own robots.txt, and it remains true until this desk has actually collected
through a route that is not pacom.mil and the result has been reviewed.

_timezone_note: America/New_York is the timezone the PUBLISHER emits in: every sampled
pubDate carried a US Eastern offset, because DVIDS is operated by
Defense Media Activity, not by the command in Hawaii.
It is NOT used to date records. Each item's publication date is read
from the offset that item itself declares, so a re-homed feed or a
daylight-saving change cannot silently re-date the corpus.
USINDOPACOM's own headquarters timezone is Pacific/Honolulu; the feed
does not publish in it, and claiming otherwise would be an invention.

institutions.name_original: Defense Visual Information Distribution Service (DVIDS), Defense Media Activity
institutions.notes: DVIDS is a DoD field activity distribution platform. It is the PUBLISHER of the retrieved items; it is not U.S. Pacific Command, and an item appearing here is not thereby a command release.

declared_scope: Unit-TAGGED public-affairs output carrying the USINDOPACOM tag. This is NOT a USINDOPACOM command-release wire and must never be described as one.
Measured 2026-09-17, 428 items: news 171, audio 100, video 99, image 58.
Only the 171 /news/ items have retrievable prose. Image, video and audio items are counted and rejected.
Identity: the feed's own guid, form 'news:<id>', cross-checked against the id in the item link. 171/171 guids and 171/171 links unique in the measured feed.
Bodies come from the article page (div.news-body); the feed's description field is a teaser, median ~311 characters, and is not stored as a body.
Tier B, not A: the publisher is a DoD media service rather than the command speaking for itself, and the tag is applied by the submitting unit.
sources.notes: Enabled is false and stays false: this source is under shadow evaluation and has never been part of a production run. Scope, inclusions, exclusions and measured limitations are in shadow/us_indopacom/README.md.
